library-turtle-tell-1: A sea turtle swims in the sea.
library-turtle-tell-2: It must come up for air.
library-turtle-tell-3: It breathes with lungs, like us.
library-turtle-more-1: A sea turtle cannot breathe water like a fish.
library-turtle-more-2: It lifts its nose above the surface to take a breath.
library-turtle-more-3: Then it can dive back down to swim and feed.
library-turtle-deep-1: Sea turtles are reptiles with lungs, not gills.
library-turtle-deep-2: Air enters their lungs when they come to the surface.
library-turtle-deep-3: Their bodies use oxygen from that air.
library-turtle-deep-4: A resting turtle uses oxygen more slowly than an active turtle.
library-turtle-deep-5: Dive length varies with activity, temperature, and the turtle’s condition.
library-busy-page-1: Today is a very busy day! Mama and I have lots of things to do and see.
library-busy-page-2: We walk to the station and find people in a queue. Old people and young people, loud people and quiet people, all going to town.
library-busy-page-3: Through the minibus window, I see cars driving by. Fast cars and slow cars, big cars and small cars.
library-busy-page-4: There are so many buildings in town! Tall ones and short ones, glass ones and brick ones, everywhere I look.
library-busy-page-5: Mama and I walk in and out of shops. Shops for clothes and shops for books, shops for bags and all sorts of things.
library-busy-page-6: Mama tries on some shoes. Red shoes and green shoes, high shoes and low shoes.
library-busy-page-9: In a big store, we fill a trolley with food. Boxes of cereal, and sacks of fruit. Bags of flour and bottles of juice.
library-busy-page-10: Mama shows me the toys and asks me to choose! There are soft toys and round toys, loud toys and fast toys.
library-busy-page-11: Today we’ve bought lots of things! Bags of food and bags of clothes. A pair of shoes and even some treats.
library-busy-page-12: Back at home, in our quiet house, I take out the special gift that Mama bought just for me!
library-busy-page-14: Today is a very busy day. Come to town with Mama and me!
